_comment: bits store writer (M8a): the third security-proxy instance. Its only route, s3, holds the store keypair the orchestrator worker writes its signed manifests with. Only the worker mounts its agent socket and shares its network (store-net), so the backend cannot use it. Copy to STORE_WRITER_CONFIG_DIR as config.json (root-owned, read-only). Its slots (s3-access-<bucket>, s3-secret-<bucket>) and a throwaway client certificate are pushed by `make unlock` (tools/service-secrets.py); until then the route answers 503.

routes._comment: M8b: a bits-manifests project token that may push to its main branch; the worker mirrors the certified set it owns there. Here, not in the credentials proxy, so the backend can never push to bits-manifests. Leave it out until the switch.
routes.name: gitlab-mirror
